detail: Full summary: Test note: my first convergence test did not discriminate — under last-writer-wins, writing a/,b/,a/,b/ ends at b/ either way. Rewrote it to write a/,b/ then a/ AGAIN, which flips the value back under the old semantics and is a no-op under a union. Three of the eight tests now fail against unfixed code.
